name: Finder — Auto-Generated Reference
masteryNotes: 101 shortcuts, 285 menu items. All views, navigation, file ops, Get Info, Quick Look, Smart Folders, Tags, AirDrop, Server connect, Compress, Search verified. NSSavePanel + NSOpenPanel fully mapped with exact AX paths. Settings (General/Tags/Sidebar/Advanced) and View Options fully scanned.

window.sidebar: AXOutline of AXScrollArea of AXSplitGroup of AXWindow
window.fileList: AXList of AXScrollArea of inner AXSplitGroup

nsSavePanel.description: Compact NSSavePanel — attaches as AXSheet on the triggering window
nsSavePanel.filenameField: text field 1 of sheet 1 of window <name>
nsSavePanel.tagsField: text field 2 of sheet 1 of window <name>
nsSavePanel.fileFormatPopup: pop up button "File Format:" of sheet 1
nsSavePanel.goToFolderInDialog: keystroke g using {command down, shift down} → sheet 1 of sheet 1 → text field 1 + Return
nsSavePanel.whereMenuItems: name of every menu item of menu 1 of pop up button "Where:"

nsOpenPanel.sidebar: outline 1 of scroll area 1 of splitter group 1 of window "Open"
nsOpenPanel.sidebarRows: every row of outline 1 of scroll area 1 of splitter group 1
nsOpenPanel.fileBrowser: list 1 of scroll area 1 of splitter group 1 of splitter group 1 of window "Open"
nsOpenPanel.goToFolderInDialog: keystroke g using {command down, shift down} → sheet 1 of window "Open" → text field 1 + Return
nsOpenPanel.selectFileByTyping: keystroke "filename" (navigates and selects matching file in browser)

contextMenu.openWith: AXMenu > Open With → submenu of available apps
contextMenu.quickActions: AXMenu > Quick Actions → Rotate Image, Create PDF, Trim, etc.
contextMenu.shareMenu: AXMenu > Share → AirDrop / Mail / Messages / etc.

general.desktopItems: Show items on Desktop: Hard disks / External disks / CDs / Connected servers
general.newWindowTarget: New Finder windows show: (dropdown — Recents, Desktop, Home, Documents, etc.)
general.openInTabs: Open folders in tabs instead of new windows (checkbox)
general.iCloudDriveSync: Sync Desktop and Documents to iCloud Drive (checkbox)

tags.sidebarTags: Drag colored tags to reorder/remove from sidebar
tags.favoriteTags: Bottom list: drag tags here to mark as favorites

sidebar.sections: Favorites (Recents/AirDrop/Applications/Desktop/Documents/Downloads/Movies/Music/Pictures/Home/iCloud Drive) + iCloud + Locations (Computer/Hard Disk/External/CDs/Cloud Storage) + Tags
sidebar.customise: Check/uncheck each item to show/hide in sidebar

advanced.warnOnExtensionChange: Show warning before changing an extension (checkbox)
advanced.warnRemoveFromiCloud: Show warning before removing from iCloud Drive (checkbox)
advanced.warnEmptyTrash: Show warning before emptying the Trash (checkbox)
advanced.removeTrashAfter30: Remove items from the Trash after 30 days (checkbox)
advanced.keepFoldersOnTop: Keep folders on top: In windows / On Desktop (checkbox)
advanced.searchScope: When performing a search: Search This Mac / Search the Current Folder / Use the Previous Search Scope (dropdown)

iconView.showIconPreview: checkbox — renders file content as icon
iconView.sortBy: None/Name/Kind/Date Modified/Date Created/Date Last Opened/Date Added/Size/Tags

listView.columns: Date Modified / Date Created / Date Last Opened / Date Added / Size / Kind / Version / Comments / Tags
listView.sortBy: Name/Kind/Date Modified/Date Created/Date Last Opened/Date Added/Size/Tags

viewOptions.useAsDefaults: button — applies current settings to all folders of this view type

steps: type path in Go to: text field
navigate_to_folder.notes: Works in both Finder window AND inside NSOpenPanel/NSSavePanel

create_new_folder.notes: Requires write permission. System directories prompt for Touch ID/password.

steps: set name of (item "oldName" of folder x) to "newName"
select file via AppleScript: select (item "name" of desktop)
key: Cmd+I  OR  tell application "Finder" → open information window of item
get_info.notes: Shows Kind, Size, Where, Created, Modified, Tags, Name & Extension, Sharing & Permissions

quick_look.notes: Opens floating Quick Look panel. Space toggles. Option+Cmd+Y = Slideshow.

steps: set value of text field 1 of sheet 1 of window <win> to "filename"
click menu item "<location>" of menu 1 of pop up button "Where:" of sheet 1
optionally: keystroke 'g' using {cmd,shift} → sheet 1 of sheet 1 → set value of text field 1 to "/path" → key code 36
set value of text field 1 of sheet 1 of window "Open" to "/path/to/folder"

compress_files.applescript: tell application "Finder" to compress {item "file1.txt" of desktop, item "file2.txt" of desktop}
compress_files.notes: Multiple files → Archive.zip. Single file → <name>.zip. Compress menu item appears dynamically based on selection.

steps: Cmd+I → click Tags field → type tag name → Return
drag file onto a tag in the Finder sidebar
tag_files.applescript: tell application "Finder" to set tags of file "myfile.txt" of desktop to {"Red", "Work"}
tag_files.notes: Tags are persisted as macOS extended attributes. Search by tag: Cmd+F → Kind → Tags.

steps: File > New Smart Folder (no shortcut by default)
click '+' to add criteria (Kind, Date, Name, Tag, Size, etc.)
click Save → name it → choose save location → check 'Add To Sidebar'
create_smart_folder.notes: Saved as .savedSearch bundles. Located in ~/Library/Saved Searches/. Criteria use Spotlight metadata.

steps: Cmd+F in Finder (or click search field in toolbar)
click '+' to add filter attributes: Kind / Date Modified / Tags / Size / Name contains / etc.
toggle 'This Mac' vs current folder scope
OR: Ctrl+Shift+Cmd+F → Find by Name… (name-only search, faster)
search_with_filters.notes: Search scope controlled in Finder Settings > Advanced. Results can be saved as Smart Folder.

steps: recipient must accept on their device
airdrop_file.notes: Sender + receiver must both have AirDrop enabled. Works over Bluetooth + WiFi. No internet needed.

steps: enter server address: smb://server/share, afp://server/share, nfs://server/path
click Connect → enter credentials if needed
volume mounts and appears in sidebar under Locations
connect_to_server.notes: Recent servers remembered. Favorite servers: click '+' in dialog to save. SMB is standard for Windows shares.

steps: Cmd+D → creates '<name> copy' in same folder
duplicate_file.notes: Original stays selected. Duplicate is placed adjacent. Works on folders too.

steps: alias appears with small arrow badge on icon
make_alias.applescript: tell application "Finder" to make alias file at (path to desktop) to item "<path>"
make_alias.notes: Unlike symlinks, macOS aliases track the original even if it's moved. Stored as separate file.

steps: OR drag volume icon to Trash (Trash icon becomes Eject icon)
eject_volume.notes: Safe eject: closes all open files on volume first. Use before physically removing drives.

steps: Shift+Cmd+P → Show/Hide Preview pane (right side panel)
preview shows: file metadata, image dimensions, PDF thumbnails, audio/video info
click 'More…' in preview to open Get Info
preview_pane.notes: Preview pane is separate from Quick Look. Quick Look = Cmd+Y = floating window. Preview pane = persistent side panel.

steps: Option+Cmd+P → Show/Hide Path Bar (bottom of window)
double-click any item in path bar to navigate there
drag files onto path bar items to move
path_bar.notes: Path Bar persists per-window. Shows complete path from root to current folder.

steps: Ctrl+Cmd+O → Open item in new tab
Window > Merge All Windows → combine all windows into tabs
tabs.notes: Tab bar hides automatically when only 1 tab. Tabs are per-window, not global.

steps: select file → Cmd+Delete → moves to Trash
Option+Cmd+Delete → Delete Immediately (bypass Trash, prompts confirmation)
open Trash: click Trash in Dock
recover: drag item out of Trash, OR right-click → Put Back
move_to_trash_and_recover.applescript: tell application "Finder" to move (item "file.txt" of desktop) to trash
move_to_trash_and_recover.notes: Items in Trash remain until emptied. Trash is per-volume — each disk has its own .Trash folder. Auto-delete after 30 days if enabled in Settings > Advanced.

system_folder_auth.description: New Folder in system directories (/Users, /Applications) prompts Touch ID/password
system_folder_auth.workaround: Always navigate to user-writable location (Desktop, Documents, Downloads) first

nssavepanel_elements_empty.description: NSSavePanel sheet elements return empty via AppleScript `every UI element` in some cases
nssavepanel_elements_empty.workaround: Access elements by type directly: `text field 1`, `button "Save"`, `pop up button "Where:"`

websiteFeatures.name: Icon View
websiteFeatures.description: View files as icons with configurable size (16-512px), grid spacing, label position, item info overlay, and icon preview

websiteFeatures.name: List View
websiteFeatures.description: View files in a sortable list with columns: name, size, kind, date modified, date created, date added, version, comments, tags

websiteFeatures.name: Column View
websiteFeatures.description: Navigate folder hierarchy in columns; preview column shows file content on right

websiteFeatures.name: Gallery View
websiteFeatures.description: Large visual preview of selected file with filmstrip navigation; ideal for photos and media

websiteFeatures.name: Use Groups / Use Stacks
websiteFeatures.description: Group files by Kind, Date, Size, Tags in any view. Stacks mode on Desktop groups files into piles (Ctrl+Cmd+0)

websiteFeatures.name: Sort By
websiteFeatures.description: Sort by: None, Name, Kind, Date Last Opened, Date Added, Date Modified, Size, Tags (Ctrl+Option+Cmd+0-7)

websiteFeatures.name: View Options (Cmd+J)
websiteFeatures.description: Per-folder display settings: icon size, grid spacing, text size, label position, item info, icon preview, background, group by, sort by. 'Use as Defaults' applies globally.

websiteFeatures.name: Preview Pane (Shift+Cmd+P)
websiteFeatures.description: Persistent right-side panel showing file metadata, image dimensions, PDF pages, audio/video info — no need to open file

websiteFeatures.name: Sidebar
websiteFeatures.description: Left panel with Favorites, Recents, AirDrop, iCloud Drive, connected devices, network shares, tags. Customizable via Settings > Sidebar. Toggle: Ctrl+Cmd+S

websiteFeatures.name: Toolbar
websiteFeatures.description: Back/Forward, view switcher, search field, customizable buttons. Option+Cmd+T to hide. Right-click to customize.

websiteFeatures.name: Path Bar (Option+Cmd+P)
websiteFeatures.description: Breadcrumb bar at window bottom. Double-click crumb to navigate; drag files onto crumbs to move. Shows full path from root.

websiteFeatures.name: Status Bar (Cmd+/)
websiteFeatures.description: Shows item count and available disk space at bottom of window

websiteFeatures.name: Go Location Shortcuts
websiteFeatures.description: Desktop (Shift+Cmd+D), Home (Shift+Cmd+H), Documents (Shift+Cmd+O), Downloads (Option+Cmd+L), Applications (Shift+Cmd+A), iCloud (Shift+Cmd+I), Computer (Shift+Cmd+C), AirDrop (Shift+Cmd+R), Network (Shift+Cmd+K)

websiteFeatures.name: Go to Folder (Shift+Cmd+G)
websiteFeatures.description: Type any absolute path to navigate directly. Works in Finder AND inside NSOpenPanel/NSSavePanel dialogs. Supports Tab completion.

websiteFeatures.name: Back / Forward / Enclosing Folder
websiteFeatures.description: Cmd+[ (back), Cmd+] (forward), Option+Cmd+Up (enclosing folder / parent directory)

websiteFeatures.name: Tabs
websiteFeatures.description: Cmd+T new tab, Shift+Cmd+\ all tabs overview, Ctrl+Cmd+Tab cycle, Window > Merge All Windows. Tab bar hides when only 1 tab (Shift+Cmd+T toggle)

websiteFeatures.name: Recents
websiteFeatures.description: Shift+Cmd+F opens Recents (recently opened files across all apps). Appears in sidebar. Not the same as Recent Folders in the Go menu.

websiteFeatures.name: New Folder (Shift+Cmd+N)
websiteFeatures.description: Create folder at current location with inline rename. Ctrl+Cmd+N = New Folder with Selection (wraps selected items into new folder).

websiteFeatures.name: Open With
websiteFeatures.description: Open file with specific app: right-click > Open With. Option+right-click for full list. 'Always Open With' changes default app. Or use File > Open With.

websiteFeatures.name: Duplicate (Cmd+D)
websiteFeatures.description: Creates copy in same folder with ' copy' appended. Option+Shift+Cmd+D = Duplicate Exactly (no suffix).

websiteFeatures.name: Make Alias (Ctrl+Cmd+A)
websiteFeatures.description: Creates tracked shortcut that follows original even if moved — unlike symlinks. Arrow badge on icon. AppleScript: make alias file at desktop to item.

websiteFeatures.name: Compress / ZIP Archive
websiteFeatures.description: Right-click > Compress. Single file -> <name>.zip. Multiple -> Archive.zip. Same folder as originals. AppleScript: Finder's compress command.

websiteFeatures.name: Move to Trash / Delete
websiteFeatures.description: Cmd+Delete = Trash. Option+Cmd+Delete = Delete Immediately (bypasses Trash). Shift+Cmd+Delete = Empty Trash. Recover via right-click > Put Back.

websiteFeatures.name: Copy, Paste, Move (Cut)
websiteFeatures.description: Cmd+C copy, Cmd+V paste (copies). Option+Cmd+V = Move Item Here (cut-paste equivalent). Note: Cmd+X does NOT cut files in Finder.

websiteFeatures.name: Rename File/Folder
websiteFeatures.description: Select item, press Return for inline rename. Batch rename: select multiple > right-click > Rename (Replace Text / Add Text / Format with counter/date).

websiteFeatures.name: Copy as Pathname (Option+Cmd+C)
websiteFeatures.description: Copies full POSIX path to clipboard (e.g. /Users/khushi/Documents/file.txt). Essential for scripting.

websiteFeatures.name: Eject Volume (Option+Cmd+E)
websiteFeatures.description: Safely unmounts selected disk/volume. Also: drag to Trash (icon changes to Eject). AppleScript: tell Finder to eject disk.

websiteFeatures.name: Get Info (Cmd+I)
websiteFeatures.description: File metadata: Kind, Size, Where, Created, Modified, Tags, Name & Extension, Open With, Comments, Sharing & Permissions. Option+Cmd+I = Inspector (live update). Ctrl+Cmd+I = Summary for multiple.

websiteFeatures.name: Quick Look (Cmd+Y / Space)
websiteFeatures.description: Floating preview panel without opening file. Supports images, PDFs, text, audio, video, Office docs, code. Option+Cmd+Y = Slideshow for multiple selected.

websiteFeatures.name: Show Original (Cmd+R)
websiteFeatures.description: When an alias/symlink is selected, navigates to and reveals the original file.

websiteFeatures.name: Search (Cmd+F)
websiteFeatures.description: Spotlight-powered: type to search, add filters (+): Kind, Date Modified, Date Created, Tags, Size, Name Contains, File Extension. Ctrl+Shift+Cmd+F = Find by Name only (faster). Toggle scope: This Mac vs current folder.

websiteFeatures.name: Smart Folders
websiteFeatures.description: File > New Smart Folder. Criteria-based auto-updating virtual folder (any Spotlight attribute). Save as .savedSearch. Add to sidebar. Stored in ~/Library/Saved Searches/.

websiteFeatures.name: Tags (Color Labels)
websiteFeatures.description: Apply: right-click > Tags, drag to sidebar tag, or Cmd+I > Tags field. Multiple per file. Search by tag: Cmd+F > Tags. AppleScript: set tags of file to {"Red","Work"}. Manage in Settings > Tags.

websiteFeatures.name: Customize Folder/File Icon
websiteFeatures.description: Cmd+I > click top-left icon > Cmd+V paste custom image. Emoji, screenshots, custom artwork work. Remove: click pasted icon > Delete.

websiteFeatures.name: Add to Sidebar / Dock
websiteFeatures.description: Ctrl+Cmd+T = Add to Sidebar Favorites. Ctrl+Shift+Cmd+T = Add to Dock. Drag items directly to sidebar.

websiteFeatures.name: AirDrop (Shift+Cmd+R)
websiteFeatures.description: Wireless file transfer to nearby Mac/iPhone/iPad over Bluetooth+WiFi. No internet. Drag files onto recipient. Recipient must accept.

websiteFeatures.name: Share Menu
websiteFeatures.description: Right-click > Share: AirDrop, Mail, Messages, Notes, Reminders, Add to Photos, etc. Or File > Share menu.

websiteFeatures.name: Connect to Server (Cmd+K)
websiteFeatures.description: Mount network volumes: SMB (smb://server/share), AFP (afp://), NFS (nfs://), WebDAV (http://). Mounts in sidebar > Locations. AppleScript: open location. Favorite servers saved in dialog.

websiteFeatures.name: iOS/iPadOS Device Sync
websiteFeatures.description: USB-connect iPhone/iPad/iPod -> appears in Finder sidebar. Sync music, photos, videos, podcasts, files. Backup/restore. Replaces iTunes.

websiteFeatures.name: iCloud Drive
websiteFeatures.description: ~/Library/Mobile Documents synced to iCloud. Offline toggle per file (right-click > Keep Downloaded / Remove Download). Sync Desktop+Docs in Settings > General.

websiteFeatures.name: Quick Actions
websiteFeatures.description: Right-click > Quick Actions: context-sensitive operations like Rotate Image, Create PDF, Trim Video, Markup. Customize in System Settings > Extensions > Finder.

websiteFeatures.name: New Terminal at Folder
websiteFeatures.description: Right-click folder or background > New Terminal at Folder. Opens Terminal.app at that path. Enable in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Extensions > Finder.

websiteFeatures.name: Burn to Disc
websiteFeatures.description: File > New Burn Folder (when optical drive present). Drag items in, click Burn. Or insert blank disc and it appears in sidebar.

websiteFeatures.name: Finder Settings (Cmd+,)
websiteFeatures.description: 4 tabs: General (desktop items, new window target, tabs, iCloud sync), Tags (sidebar tags), Sidebar (toggle all sidebar items), Advanced (extensions, warnings, trash behavior, folder sorting, search scope).

websiteFeatures.name: NSSavePanel Dialog Automation
websiteFeatures.description: Compact sheet on triggering window. text field 1 = filename, text field 2 = tags, pop up button 'Where:', pop up button 'File Format:', button 'Save'/'Cancel'. Navigate via Cmd+Shift+G inside dialog.

websiteFeatures.name: NSOpenPanel Dialog Automation
websiteFeatures.description: Standalone window 'Open'. Sidebar: outline 1 of scroll area 1 of splitter group 1. Files: list 1 of scroll area 1 of splitter group 1 of splitter group 1. Navigate Cmd+Shift+G, type filename to select, click Open.

valueAddFeatures.name: Bulk Create
valueAddFeatures.description: Create multiple Finder items from a list or template

valueAddFeatures.name: Auto-Organize
valueAddFeatures.description: Sort and organize Finder items by content, date, or type

valueAddFeatures.name: Summarize
valueAddFeatures.description: Read and summarize all Finder content

valueAddFeatures.name: Change Monitor
valueAddFeatures.description: Monitor Finder for changes and notify
